title: Port feedback-loop-diagnosis skill into opum-workflow
description: Source: opum-agent tooling/codex-skills/feedback-loop-diagnosis/SKILL.md, read-only from this side until the port ships (then delete there). Per OPAG-51's user-authorised port decision (2026-09-06, AskUserQuestion): port feedback-loop-diagnosis ONLY for now; tdd-seams and deep-module-design are decided later, gated on whether this port's baseline arm actually fails. decision-grilling is explicitly NOT ported (its own eval showed baseline unaided at 0.67 -- selection-by-cost-of-measurement mistake). Ship gate: ./scripts/run-eval.sh feedback-loop-diagnosis, 3 runs, --ablation with-without, sonnet-tier judge, one behavioural case whose baseline arm fails plus a no-trigger guard, authored against opum-agent docs/reference/plugin-eval-authoring.md -- read its three recorded grader defects (over-specified failure lists colliding with permission clauses) before writing the case so the criteria do not contain their own exception. Report the run result and cost back to opum-agent; the tdd-seams follow-on decision depends on it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: feedback-loop-diagnosis skill is ported into this plugin's skills/ with a behavioural eval case whose baseline arm fails
no-trigger guard case exists for the skill and passes (delta 0.00, both arms at parity)
./scripts/run-eval.sh feedback-loop-diagnosis passes at 3 runs with --ablation with-without and a sonnet-tier judge, or is recorded as evaluated-and-not-yet-passing with a diagnosed reason
run result and cost reported back to opum-agent to unblock the tdd-seams decision

implementationNotes: Four eval case designs, each empirically piloted (claude plugin eval --case ... --runs N): (1) memoize/cache-key bug with the exact colliding sequence handed to the model -- fixture contained the answer, both arms solved it via static reading. (2) same bug, vaguer symptom -- judge variance on near-identical responses (n=1 delta -0.67, wrong direction). (3) epistemic-restraint framing -- n=1 delta 0.67, n=3 collapsed to 0.00, noise. (4) feedback-loop-diagnosis-stale-fix-claim, scaffolded 3-file investigation modeled on handoff-write-mechanics -- shipped case, n=3: with 1.00/1.00/1.00, without 1.00/1.00/1.00, delta 0.000 exactly. Skill tool fired 0 times in every with-arm run across all four designs.

./scripts/run-eval.sh feedback-loop-diagnosis exits 0 ($4.36 total, both cases 1.00 in both arms, no regression to any other skill's guard) -- satisfies criterion 2's literal text but not criterion 0's bar (a case whose baseline arm fails), which no design achieved.

Acknowledging opum-agent OPAG-65's release freeze: no opum-workflow plugin.json version bump until wave 3 of the fleet backlog-bug-wave-and-stacked-release campaign. OPAG-52 (in progress, OMARK-13), OPAG-62 (queued, matches this repo's fix/OMARK-10-notify-orchestrator-fixture draft PR #18), and OPAG-63 (queued) each land on dev behind their own eval gate / hooks fixture, serially, with the version bump on the last of the three -- not on OPAG-52.
finalSummary: Skill ported to skills/opum-feedback-loop-diagnosis/SKILL.md, rewritten not translated (dropped the $tdd-seams macro load since tdd-seams is unshipped, and the 'active coordination plane' phrase, which named FMC without saying so, in favor of AskUserQuestion). Held: zero measured lift from the skill across four eval iterations, full numbers in implementation notes. Ruling from opum-agent (2026-09-07): not ported. The four-pilot result and the user's 'port only what is justified' plus tdd-seams/deep-module-design follow-on rule settle it -- both those follow-ons stop here too, closing OPAG-51 with none of the remaining eight skills ported and a recorded reason each. This Done status marks a decision, not shipped work: draft PR opum-marketplace#21 (the actual skill/eval files) was closed without merging and its branch deleted, per the ruling and the user's confirmation -- recoverable from that closed PR's diff if ever revisited, but not present on dev.
